message.content:
Here are some well‑known documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore’s campaign to raise awareness about climate change, featuring scientific data and personal stories. |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film, with new footage from the Paris Agreement negotiations. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change and discusses solutions. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that explains the science behind global warming, its effects, and policy responses. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from scientists, activists, and business leaders. |
| **“Our Planet”** (Season 1) | 2019 | While not solely about climate change, this nature series highlights how warming affects ecosystems worldwide. |
| **“The Age of Consequences”** | 2020 | Explores how climate change is reshaping geopolitics, economics, and security. |
| **“Heat”** | 2020 | A short documentary that follows a team of scientists as they investigate the causes of extreme heat events. |

All of these are available on major streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or through public broadcasters like PBS and BBC. If you’d like more details on any particular film or need help finding where to watch it, just let me know!
